checks.code:
import pandas as pd
s = pd.DataFrame({"date": pd.to_datetime(["2024-01-15","2024-02-10","2024-03-05","2025-01-20","2025-02-12","2025-02-25","2025-03-08","2025-03-30"]),
 "region": ["North","South","North","South","North","West","West","South"], "product": ["Pen","Mouse","Keyboard","Pen","Mouse","Keyboard","Pen","Mouse"],
 "qty": [10,2,1,20,3,2,5,1], "price": [10,450,900,10,450,900,10,450], "cid": ["C1","C2","C3","C1","C4","C2","C5","C3"]})
s["amount"] = s.qty * s.price
c = pd.DataFrame({"cid": ["C1","C2","C3","C4","C5"], "segment": ["Retail","B2B","Retail","B2B","Retail"]})
m = s.merge(c, on="cid")
total = s.amount.sum(); units = s.qty.sum()
y25 = s[s.date.dt.year == 2025]; y24 = s[s.date.dt.year == 2024]
reg = s.groupby("region").amount.sum(); prod = s.groupby("product").amount.sum()

assert total == 5750, 'Total Sales'
assert len(s) == 8, 'Number of orders'
assert s.cid.nunique() == 5, 'Unique customers'
assert s.amount.mean() == 718.75, 'Average order'
assert units == 44, 'Units sold'
assert (s.qty * s.price).sum() == 5750, 'Row-by-row revenue'
assert s.amount.max() == 1800, 'Biggest order'
assert round(total / units, 2) == 130.68, 'Average price per unit'
assert total / s.cid.nunique() == 1150, 'Sales per customer'
assert True, 'Divide by zero, safely'
assert reg["North"] == 2350, 'Only North'
assert s[s["product"] == "Pen"].qty.sum() == 35, 'Only pens'
assert (s.amount > 500).sum() == 4, 'Orders above 500'
assert total == 5750, 'Ignore the region filter'
assert round(reg["North"] / total * 100, 1) == 40.9, 'Share of total'
assert m[m.segment == "B2B"].amount.sum() == 4050, 'Sales from B2B customers'
assert (m.segment == "Retail").sum() == 5, 'Orders from Retail'
assert (s.amount > 500).sum() == 4, 'Same count, with FILTER'
assert s[(s.region == "South") & (s["product"] == "Mouse")].amount.sum() == 1350, 'Two conditions'
assert y25.amount.sum() == 3850, 'Year to date'
assert y24.amount.sum() == 1900, 'Same period last year'
assert round((y25.amount.sum() - y24.amount.sum()) / y24.amount.sum() * 100, 1) == 102.6, 'Year-on-year growth'
assert y25[y25.date.dt.month == 2].amount.sum() == 3150, 'Last month'
assert list(reg.sort_values(ascending=False).index) == ["North", "West", "South"], 'Rank regions'
assert prod["Mouse"] == prod["Keyboard"] == 2700 and prod["Pen"] == 350, 'Rank with a tie'
assert round(reg.mean(), 2) == 1916.67, 'Average across regions'
assert m.loc[0, "segment"] == "Retail", 'Bring in a column (calc column)'
print('dax answers ok')

manual.snippet: % of Total = DIVIDE([Total Sales], CALCULATE([Total Sales], ALL(Sales)))
South Mouse = CALCULATE([Total Sales], Sales[Region] = "South", Sales[Product] = "Mouse")
Last Month = CALCULATE([Total Sales], DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, MONTH))
